title: Data Explorer
description: Learn to analyse small-scale fisheries data with interactive R lessons that run in your browser.

intro.title: Interactive R, right in your browser
intro.body: Each lesson runs real R code against your own landings data — the same data and access permissions as the Data Download tab. Nothing to install. Pick a lesson to get started.

intro.title: Welcome — your first look at the data
intro.description: Start here. What R is, how this page works, and your first results — no experience needed.

dataset.title: Getting to know your data
dataset.description: What's inside your data — what each row is, what the columns mean, and how trips and catches fit together. Browse your own records.

filter.title: Find the rows you need
filter.description: Show only the landings you care about — one site, one month, one kind of fish. Content coming soon.

select.title: Pick the columns you need
select.description: Keep just the columns that matter, like date, site and weight. Content coming soon.

summarise.title: Add it up
summarise.description: Total and average your catch by site, gear or month to answer everyday questions. Content coming soon.
